name: Ba Be
blurb: Online conversation regarding Ba Be is currently quiet, reflecting 0% growth versus baseline. Recent posts highlight activities such as kayaking on Ba Be Lake, cycling in Ba Be National Park, and taking long boat rides from the lake to the Nang River.

positive: Spotting butterfly species like the blue admiral in Ba Be National Park
Enjoying boat trips from Ba Be Lake to the Nang River, Puong Cave, and local islands
Affordable lodging costs under $40 for two nights and opportunities for kayaking
negative: Critique of large-scale investments aiming to turn the destination into an eco-tourism site

quotes.text:
One of my many wildlife lists is my bicycle list: all #butterfly species I see sitting on a bicycle I ride. I can now officially put blue admiral, Kaniska canace, on my bicycle list! 
In Ba Be National Park in N Vietnam.
#dailylepi

Bac Kan National Park. Long boat from Ba Be Lake to Nang River. Puong Cave and Temple on Den En Ma island. Bo Lu village is home to Tay ethnic people. Fishing, farming. Now tourism. Huge investment to make this an “eco-tourism” destination. No such thing. Beauty is the lack of development.
Ba Be in Bac Kan. <$40 for two nights. Overpriced hotpot (sorry chickens). Fish farms. Rice. Corn. Greens. Getting developed now. Off season. More tourists in the future. Peace. Now.
